type node = Xote.RuntimeNode.node =
  | Element({
      tag: string,
      attrs: array<(string, attrValue)>,
      events: array<(string, Dom.event => unit)>,
      children: array<node>,
    })
  | Text(string)

  | SignalFragment(Xote.Signal.t<array<node>>)

      keyFn: Obj.t => string,
      renderItem: Obj.t => node,
    })
